title: Why Gold Is Going Up Is Not What You Think

Gold is up 34.8% over the past year and 12.8% in the past month. But it still closed 16.4% below its January 29 high of $495.90.

We ran the correlation ourselves: GLD versus the dollar (UUP), daily returns, 254 trading days. The result is -0.39 - negative, but far from a one-to-one link. A weaker dollar helps gold. It has not been enough to make a new record.

Data: GLD and UUP daily closes, Aug 15 2025 to Aug 20 2026.
